title: OAuth2 scopes per operation.
text: `#[Api(security:)]` writes each scheme with an empty scope list, in the `security` arm of `operation`. Scopes need a field on `#[Api]` and a check of each scope against the flows its `#[Api\Scheme]` declares, which `rule:routing/a-security-scheme-is-declared-in-code` would gain as a field-table row.
